opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin-related packages costing approximately 100 to 5,000 euros, claiming that included tokens can generate coins that return money to purchasers. It strengthens that solicitation with projected returns of double to quadruple or much larger amounts, package calculations reaching $253,825, and an instruction to buy immediately before mining difficulty changes. A millionaire testimonial, predicted price chart, and claimed external validation lend support to this paid mining offer. Together, these claims establish a scam solicitation built around purchasing packages for projected mining returns, although the records do not establish that the transactions, valuations, projected returns, or claimed verification were authentic or achieved.
